hypotheses.storyTitle: Review Balance and Statement Credit Progress
hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: The customer reviews their 7,300 LBG coins and tracks progress toward their holiday spending money goal.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer visits the rewards overview to inspect accumulated coins and cash-equivalent value.
hypotheses.storyTension: Ensuring the exact bill-reducing value of current points is clearly understood without promotional noise.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Clear display of points balance, cash-equivalent value, and current goal progress.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Effortless verification of reward balance and direct application toward bill-reducing statement credits.

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: The customer applies available reward value directly toward reducing their card statement balance.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer seeks to convert earned LBG coins into direct financial relief on their linked card.
hypotheses.storyTension: Navigating redemption pathways efficiently with guaranteed, predictable value conversion.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Seamless one-touch statement credit application aligned with payment utility preferences.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Frictionless conversion of reward coins into statement credit bill reduction.
